alfombra: the tall captain sitting on the red carpet crosses his arms tighter and turns his head away stubbornly, the two policemen lean toward him and wave their hands angrily
discusion: the referee in black and the tall captain argue face to face, both waving their hands, players around react
expulsion: the referee in black points firmly to the side again and again, the tall captain opens his arms in protest and shakes his head
policias: two policemen walk forward escorting the tall captain by the arms, he walks slowly with his chin up, the crowd behind moves
